causality.anchor: UTC epoch multiples of 10 seconds using the latest quote timestamp <= anchor with maximum age 2 seconds.
causality.current_mid: (bid_t + ask_t) / 2 at the eligible anchor quote.
causality.future_mid: latest eligible quote timestamp <= anchor+60s, strictly after anchor, age relative to horizon <=2s; never search after the horizon.
causality.trailing_window: (anchor-15s, anchor] for recent volatility, activity and impulse.
causality.spread_baseline: median spread of the preceding six eligible 10-second anchors, excluding current anchor.
causality.missingness: No interpolation, synthesis or forward fill across gaps; an unavailable feature or outcome makes only that estimand row ineligible.

exposure.name: spread_dislocation_state
exposure.contrast: WIDE=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q5; TIGHT=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q1; Q2-Q4 excluded from the primary contrast.
exposure.boundaries: Reuse exact Phase 22A 2019-2021 pair-specific boundaries; never refit or optimize.
exposure.effect_orientation: WIDE minus TIGHT. Negative movement effect means lower subsequent absolute movement in WIDE state.

primary_raw_pips.estimand: mean(WIDE)-mean(TIGHT), first within pair x UTC trading day and then equal-weighted across available pair-days

secondary_current_spread_units.role: mechanical-normalization diagnostic only; cannot establish a genuine phenomenon by itself

secondary_trailing_spread_units.role: denominator diagnostic independent of current spread

secondary_fixed_scale.definition: Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS/pair-specific median current spread estimated once on 2019-2021 and frozen

controls.fit_rule: All numeric boundaries use pair-specific empirical quintiles estimated on 2019-2021 only and frozen for 2022/2023; no threshold search.
controls.recent_micro_volatility: sum absolute nonzero mid changes over (t-15s,t], in pips; retain continuous log1p value and frozen quintile.
controls.quote_activity: quote count over (t-15s,t] divided by one quarter of quote count over nonoverlapping (t-75s,t-15s]; retain continuous log1p ratio and frozen quintile; denominator zero is missing.
controls.time_of_day: fixed UTC hour categorical 0-23; weekday categorical Monday-Friday; no data-derived session boundaries.
controls.recent_directional_impulse: mid_t minus causal as-of mid at t-15s, in raw pips; encode sign {-1,0,+1} and frozen quintile of absolute magnitude.
controls.pair: fixed categorical EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCAD; pooled estimates weight pair-days equally.

broader_liquidity_state.baseline_micro_volatility: sum absolute mid changes in (t-75s,t-15s] in pips

models_and_estimands.implementation_equivalence: Two implementations are equivalent only when row eligibility, exact ordered column names, every matrix value, weights, and extracted statistics are byte-identical after canonical serialization.
models_and_estimands.interaction_matrix_rule: For each interaction_tests record, copy the named base model exactly, append any explicitly listed added_main_effect_columns, then append added_columns in listed order. normalization_artifact_tests.classification_boundary: Failures of raw-pip or denominator-independent effect/stability gates are evaluated only when assigning NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT; they do not alter H_NORM, its p-value, or its FDR membership.

inference.primary_unit: UTC trading-day block; pair-day estimates are observations for named pooled contrasts, while frozen WLS operates on eligible anchor rows with pair-day weights.

estimator_contract.estimator: weighted least squares (WLS) using the frozen row weights
estimator_contract.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 only; inputs and ordered design matrix must contain finite values
estimator_contract.transformed_system: Xw = sqrt(w) columnwise-multiplied into X rows; yw = sqrt(w)*y; zero or negative weights invalidate the run
estimator_contract.solver: LAPACK DGELSD singular-value least squares through an implementation pinned in the implementation manifest
estimator_contract.rank_rule: rank is count(singular_value > rcond * largest_singular_value); rank must equal K
estimator_contract.coefficient_order: exact model coefficient_names order; extraction by exact name only
estimator_contract.residual: unweighted residual e_i = y_i - x_i beta; weighted estimating score uses w_i*x_i*e_i
estimator_contract.failure: Any non-finite input/output, rank failure, condition failure, solver warning/error, or coefficient-name mismatch yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN before scientific classification.

covariance_and_wald_contract.estimator: UTC-day clustered CR1 sandwich covariance for coefficient/Wald diagnostics
covariance_and_wald_contract.cluster: UTC calendar date; all pairs for a date are one cluster
covariance_and_wald_contract.bread: inverse(X transpose W X), computed from the accepted DGELSD SVD as V*diag(1/s^2)*V transpose; no pseudoinverse of a rank-deficient matrix
covariance_and_wald_contract.cluster_score: u_g = sum over rows i in UTC day g of w_i*x_i*e_i
covariance_and_wald_contract.correction: G/(G-1) * (N-1)/(N-K), where G=distinct UTC days, N=eligible rows, K=columns
covariance_and_wald_contract.requirements: G>1, N>K, finite symmetric covariance, and every tested restriction covariance positive definite under the same rcond=1e-12 rank rule
covariance_and_wald_contract.wald: For ordered restriction coefficient vector b and matching covariance V, W=b transpose inverse(V) b; df=length(b); p=upper-tail chi-square(df), evaluated by scipy.stats.chi2.sf in the pinned environment.
covariance_and_wald_contract.failure: Any unmet requirement or inversion/rank/non-finite failure yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

bootstrap_contract.unit: UTC calendar day; all eligible rows for every pair on a sampled day travel together
bootstrap_contract.stratification: Within each calendar year present in the stage, independently sample with replacement exactly D_y draws from the ASCII-sorted list of D_y distinct eligible UTC dates.
bootstrap_contract.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)); process years ascending; draw integer indices with Generator.integers(0,D_y,size=D_y,endpoint=False); iteration order 0..9999.
bootstrap_contract.duplicated_days: Each repeated draw receives a deterministic copy index and contributes a full copied day block. Pair-day row weights are recomputed inside each copy so each eligible copied pair-day totals one.
bootstrap_contract.stage_fit: Concatenate copied blocks in year-ascending, draw-position, timestamp, pair-ASCII order; rebuild the exact frozen matrix; refit the same WLS estimator. No bootstrap resample may change boundaries, eligibility rules, columns, or models.
bootstrap_contract.estimand_aggregation: For model coefficients, use the single refitted stage coefficient. For named contrasts, first compute each copied pair-day contrast, average equally over copied pair-days within year, then average constituent calendar-year estimates equally in ascending year order.
bootstrap_contract.invalid_resample: Any resample fit or required statistic failure invalidates the entire research run; do not skip, redraw, replace, or reduce B.
bootstrap_contract.confidence_interval: Percentile CI from all 10000 finite bootstrap statistics using numpy.quantile method=linear at q=0.025 and 0.975; sorted binary64 values; no BCa/studentization.
bootstrap_contract.h_raw_p_value: For negative alternative, p=(1 + count(theta_b >= 0))/(10000+1). Exact zeros and signed zeros count in the null-side numerator; NaN/infinite values invalidate the run. No doubled/two-sided value controls H_RAW.
bootstrap_contract.two_sided_diagnostic: p=minimum(1, 2*minimum((1+count(theta_b<=0))/(B+1),(1+count(theta_b>=0))/(B+1))); zeros count in both tails; diagnostic only.
bootstrap_contract.reproducibility: Repeat from identical ordered inputs and seed; coefficients, statistics, p-values, quantiles, and canonical serialized bootstrap summary must be byte-identical or the run is invalid.

permutation_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; never changes advancement or classification
permutation_diagnostic.mechanism: Within each pair-day, permute WIDE/TIGHT labels independently inside the Cartesian strata UTC-hour x volatility-quintile x activity-quintile.
permutation_diagnostic.ordering: Pair-days sorted date then pair ASCII; strata sorted hour 00..23, vol Q1..Q5, activity Q1..Q5; rows sorted timestamp then source sequence.
permutation_diagnostic.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(22003)); 10000 iterations; Fisher-Yates behavior of Generator.permutation on ordered label arrays.
permutation_diagnostic.invalidity: Missing required stratum metadata, nondeterministic ordering, or non-finite required output yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

multiple_testing.algorithm: Within each family and stage, sort by (raw_p ascending,hypothesis_id ASCII ascending). Missing/non-finite tests invalidate the run. For m tests, adjusted p at sorted rank i is min(1, minimum over j>=i of m*p_j/j). Reject the largest rank k with p_k <= q*k/m and all ranks <=k. Ties retain hypothesis-ID order. No pooling across stages. H_RAW is sole primary and unadjusted.
multiple_testing.h_mixed: REMOVED; MIXED_MECHANISM is a deterministic classification over named corrected tests and attenuation gates, not a hypothesis.

inference.missing_cell_rule: Do not impute. A scientific contrast cell requires at least 20 eligible anchors per exposure group and a pair-day requires both groups. Failure of a scientific sample-size/cell requirement, after all operational checks pass, yields PHENOMENON_NOT_CONFIRMED; malformed/missing provenance or inability to calculate eligibility yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.
inference.software_determinism: Pin Python, NumPy, SciPy, BLAS/LAPACK vendor and versions in the implementation manifest; force single-thread linear algebra; stable timestamp and ASCII categorical sorting; canonical JSON and SHA-256 for every stage.

effect_size_and_stability.raw_pip_minimum: A genuine effect requires pooled adjusted WIDE-minus-TIGHT <= -0.05 pips at 60 seconds and a 95% CI wholly below zero in each advancement stage.
effect_size_and_stability.retention_after_adjustment: M4 magnitude must be at least 50% of M0 and retain the negative sign.
effect_size_and_stability.pair_stability: Negative adjusted sign in at least 3 of 4 pairs; no one pair may exceed 50% of summed absolute pair effects.
effect_size_and_stability.development_year_stability: Negative adjusted sign separately in 2019, 2020 and 2021.
effect_size_and_stability.temporal_replication: Unchanged negative adjusted sign, <=-0.05 pips and CI below zero in 2022 and separately in 2023.
effect_size_and_stability.session_stability: Report every fixed session. Genuine classification requires negative sign in at least three of asian, london_pre_overlap, overlap and new_york_post_overlap; off_session is descriptive.
effect_size_and_stability.concentration: Top five UTC days <50% of total absolute daily effect and largest month <50% of summed absolute month effects.
effect_size_and_stability.threshold_provenance: Every numeric effect, attenuation, concentration, cell-size, and replication threshold in this section was selected after aggregate Phase 22A evidence was observed. These are post-observation Phase 22B decision thresholds, not preregistered Phase 22A thresholds; claims are limited to retrospective internal replication.

confounding_rules.material_attenuation: A control block materially confounds when its addition causes >=50% attenuation versus the immediately preceding model, or reverses sign, and the adjusted CI includes zero or violates the -0.05 pip minimum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.partial_attenuation: 25% to <50% attenuation with retained sign is evidence for a mixed mechanism, not full explanation.
confounding_rules.interaction_evidence: An interaction family matters only if BH-FDR survives and the exposure effect fails the frozen stability requirement in at least one prespecified stratum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.pair_specific: Fewer than 3 pairs retain negative adjusted sign, or one pair contributes >=50% of summed absolute pair effects, consistently in 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.threshold_provenance: All attenuation and contribution cutoffs are post-observation Phase 22B decision thresholds and do not support pristine-confirmation claims.

terminal_classification_algorithm.rule: Any operational_validation trigger is true; evaluated first.

H_RAW passes all frozen raw-pip effect, adjustment, temporal replication, pair, session and concentration gates; no full confounder rule passes. This is not independent future confirmation and is non-actionable.
Current-spread-unit effect replicates but frozen raw and denominator-independent requirements fail and amplification ratio >=4 in both temporal replications.
M2 material attenuation and corresponding omnibus interaction FDR decision replicate in 2022 and 2023.
Frozen session sensitivity or M4 liquidity block meets its confounding criterion with replicating corrected omnibus evidence.
Frozen pair-specific criterion holds in both temporal replications.
At least two named blocks each meet partial attenuation or corrected replicating interaction criteria while raw effect remains; no standalone prior class applies.
No prior scientific class applies or scientific evidence is insufficient without an operational-invalid trigger.

advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2022: 2019-2021 implementation passes leakage and QA; H_RAW and all frozen v4 mechanism diagnostics are complete and artifact-frozen. Mechanism candidates are not selected or changed; every frozen v4 test advances unchanged.
advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2023: 2022 artifact is complete, hash-frozen and independently validated; no definitions, models, thresholds, directions or classifications changed.
advancement_and_rejection.phase22b_success: Only GENUINE_SPREAD_STATE_PHENOMENON may be called a confirmed genuine mechanism candidate. Other classifications are informative closures and do not authorize strategy work.
advancement_and_rejection.reject_genuine_claim: Any raw-pip minimum, CI, temporal, pair, session, concentration or adjustment-retention criterion fails.
advancement_and_rejection.insufficient_evidence: After and only after all operational checks pass: insufficient eligible scientific sample/cells or failure of a scientific effect/stability criterion yields PHENOMENON_NOT_CONFIRMED. Any integrity, leakage, authorization, provenance, determinism, estimator, bootstrap, or reproducibility failure yields exclusively PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

Trailing 15-second features exclude future ticks; baseline window is nonoverlapping and ends at anchor-15s.
Current spread and causal trailing median exclude future quotes and the current anchor is excluded from its own baseline.
All quintile boundaries and fixed scales are fit using 2019-2021 only; serialized hashes are unchanged in 2022/2023.
2022 cannot be opened before the development mechanism artifact is frozen; 2023 cannot be opened before 2022 is frozen.
No file whose timestamps reach 2024-01-01 is enumerated, sampled, counted, hashed or read.
Perturbing ticks after an anchor cannot change its exposure, controls or current denominators.
Perturbing 2022/2023 cannot change development boundaries, formulas, model matrix or classification rules.
Duplicate timestamps are stable-sorted and handled by the existing frozen quote ordering; missing/gap rows are never filled.
Input dataset root, Phase 22A evidence hashes and candidate ID must match before execution.
required_reporting: Anchor and pair-day attrition by reason, pair, year and month.
M0-M4 raw-pip coefficients, CIs, attenuation and daily distributions.
All four outcome scales side by side; never omit raw pips.
Pair, year, month, weekday, session/hour and liquidity-stratum stability.
Every interaction test, raw and FDR-adjusted p-value, including rejections.
Deterministic terminal classification with every rule truth value.

new horizons, lookbacks, pairs, sessions, outcomes, controls or interactions after freeze

hypothesis_inventory.raw_p_value: p=(1+count of 10000 daily-block bootstrap exposure__WIDE coefficients >=0)/10001; exact and signed zeros count >=0; any non-finite replicate invalidates the run
hypothesis_inventory.advancement_gate_separation: Statistical rejection of H_RAW does not itself establish classification; post-observation effect/stability/confounding gates apply separately.

hypothesis_inventory.statistic: R=abs(delta_current_spread_units)/abs(delta_fixed_scale), using stage-level M0 pair-day weighted contrasts
hypothesis_inventory.raw_p_value: One-sided upper bootstrap p=(1+count(R_b < 4))/10001 over exactly 10000 finite bootstrap replicates; R_b exactly 4 is not counted in the null-side numerator; zero fixed-scale denominator or any non-finite R_b yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.
hypothesis_inventory.threshold_provenance: The ratio cutoff 4 was chosen after aggregate Phase 22A evidence was observed. It is a post-observation Phase 22B diagnostic decision threshold and is non-confirmatory.
hypothesis_inventory.classification_separation: H_NORM tests only R against 4. Raw-pip, trailing-spread-unit, fixed-scale, effect-size, and stability gate failures are not part of this null or alternative; they are evaluated only by terminal_classification_algorithm.NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT after all operational checks pass.
